name: maint-leak
description: M4 Phase 3b scenario (epic #163; timers): the Maintenance Room leak and its clock event MNTIN. Fresh boot by <FLOAD "77loadall.mud"> and <SAVE-IT> on the fixed session clock (fixed_epoch 250776000, zone UTC, microseconds 0); unmodified pinned sources, START seeds RANDOM from DSKDATE, no RANDOM override and no seed search. The first sixteen commands are troll-combat's (the sword kills the troll at the third blow under this clock and seed), then `north` to the East-West Passage, `north` to the Deep Ravine, `down` to Reservoir South, `up` to the Deep Canyon, `east` to the Dam, `north` to the Dam Lobby and `north` to the Maintenance Room (the Loud Room route through the Echo Room is avoided: ECHO-ROOM reads its own input without a prompt). `push blue button` (MAINT-ROOM 77act1.mud:737: the leak, RVARS 1, <CLOCK-INT ,MNTIN -1>: MNTIN fires on every clock tick and raises the water level, printing it while the hero is in the room), `look`, `take tube`, `open tube`, `take putty`, `wait` (several clock ticks), `plug leak with putty` (LEAK-FUNCTION: RVARS -1, <CLOCK-INT ,MNTIN 0>: the clock stops), `wait`, `look`, `push blue button` (jammed), `south`, `score`. Each command was confirmed by the pinned native reference (captured twice, byte-identical transcripts). NATIVE REFERENCE ONLY, not a gated scenario: this runtime stops at command 23 on entering the Maintenance Room (MAINT-ROOM's attached #DECL names the undefined type PRSOBJ; INV-11). Tracked as an expected failure by tests/historical_dam_frontier_test.rkt (make xfail-m4-dam-frontier); see docs/evidence/M4/DAM-CLOCKS.md. Input ends after `score` (D3 end-of-input applies).
